located_observations.observation: The same two bold Myeongjo title lines remain immediately recognizable, with full Hangul syllables and open counters.
All four body lines read continuously; larger Hangul body, stable baselines, generous leading and distinct word gaps give the full paragraph an easy reading area.
Title remains the first text anchor. Window light and diagonal building boundary lead toward the bright footprint chain, then the larger grouped paragraph in the lower opening.

located_observations.location: upper right through center to lower right and left rail bank
located_observations.observation: Buildings and ground now meet in one continuous black field, with ivory window slots, thin wire cuts, rail cuts and a descending chain of broad bright foot marks. The separate pale receding alley and stairs have disappeared.
One orange window plane provides a single noticed light; it is more vivid than the intended muted orange.

located_observations.location: lower right foot marks, x≈77–93%, y≈77–94%
located_observations.observation: Foreground white foot shapes are clearly negative forms inside the black silhouette, but their toe and heel contours remain rounded, with rough cut rims.

Black/ivory shape boundaries are mostly clean, with small irregular carved edges around foot marks; no perspective lighting or shading is needed to identify windows, wires and walking traces. Small architectural details remain representational.

layout.observations: Two title lines and four body lines use soft breaks at original word boundaries.

text.additional_copy_observation: Only the two supplied copy blocks appear; no invented subtitle, eyebrow, dates, places, footer, logo, QR, watermark or other lettering observed.
text.raster_unicode_limit: Inspection records visible glyph and punctuation appearance; it does not authenticate source Unicode code points.

style.checked_requirement: Connected diagonal black city silhouette formed by short ivory incisions and broad openings, one small orange light; mature Myeongjo title and body.
style.observed: Continuous black urban mass and negative ivory footprint cuts now realize the assigned central relation; window/wire boundaries create the light/traces motif. Buildings retain concrete representational details and foreground foot contours are less angular than planned.

ratio.maximum_resolution_claim: requested in prompt; supported maximum not independently proved

substantive_visual.observation: Large connected city forms, carved windows and wires, and bright descending walking traces substantively organize the poster and evoke looking up and down while walking.
substantive_visual.excluded_template_observation: The non-glyph urban shape creates the diagonal boundary and real lower reading opening; it is not subordinate imagery attached to a passive solid-field headline/information template.

typography.observation: Bold title and lower-contrast Myeongjo body have harmonious Hangul proportions and open interiors. Body hairlines, punctuation and word spaces remain legible at usage720; no rough-image cuts intrude into glyphs.

information_relationship.observation: The shared left text axis and diagonal silhouette/footmark rhythm connect the upper title with the lower four-line paragraph. Full two sentences are one continuous group; no scattered copy islands.

reference_preservation.reason: No client-supplied image or preserved reference geometry requested. The prior own poster is used only as the explicit repair target.

function_contact.reason: No literal human hand contact, product function, URL or contact information requested.

material_edge_finish.observation: Large even black forms with precise ivory incisions and selectively chipped footprint edges produce a consistent cut-print surface. Orange appears as one flat plane.

format.observation: One flat full-bleed opaque portrait poster is visible; no mockup or comparison sheet.

residuals.description: Toe and heel contours are rounded rather than long angular incision forms, although their negative polarity and walking rhythm are clear.
The orange plane is brighter and more saturated than the intended muted accent.

selection_rationale: The repair resolves the initial separated dark banks and reversed footprint polarity while keeping all copy, title recognition, urban scene and one light plane. It enlarges the continuous readable body. Remaining contour/color differences do not justify another native call.
